title: Coherent belief and opinion propagation produces more echo chambers: corrected version
abstract: arXiv:2611.25879v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The occurrence of echo chambers is a well-known phenomenon in social networks. Echo chambers are groups of agents satisfying three properties: homogeneity, i.e., sharing the same opinion, segregation, i.e., listening primarily to agents of the same group, and reinforcement, i.e., increasing opinion similarity over time. Opinion dynamics models have been used to explain how echo chambers occur through agents updating their opinions. However, social network users also exchange beliefs supporting their opinions. Here, we aim at identifying the effect of propagating beliefs together with opinions on the formation of echo chambers. For that purpose, we complement an existing opinion dynamics model with classical belief merge operations. Beliefs and opinions are also maintained coherent guided by values that agents share. We introduce measures, applying to either beliefs and opinions, to identify echo chambers based on the three properties. Th

translated_title: 连贯的信念与观点传播产生更多回音室（修正版）
translated_abstract: 回音室的出现是社交网络中一个众所周知的现象。回音室是满足以下三个属性的智能体群体：同质性，即持有相同的观点；隔离性，即主要听取同群体成员的意见；强化性，即观点相似性随时间不断增强。观点动力学模型已被用来解释回音室如何通过智能体更新其观点而产生。然而，社交网络用户还会交换支持其观点的信念。本文旨在研究信念与观点共同传播对回音室形成的影响。为此，我们用经典的信念合并操作对现有的观点动力学模型进行了补充。信念和观点在智能体共同分享的价值观引导下保持连贯性。我们引入了适用于信念和观点的度量方法，基于这三个属性来识别回音室。
tldr: 该研究通过将经典信念合并操作和基于共享价值观的信念-观点连贯性机制引入观点动力学模型，发现信念与观点的连贯传播会导致社交网络中形成更多的回音室。
